description: This file contains a JUnit test class named ImportIntegrationModule used for importing and configuring an integration module in the system. It reads a JSON file containing module data, loads the specified module, and updates the system configuration accordingly.

classes.name: ImportIntegrationModule
classes.description: A JUnit test class that imports an integration module from a JSON file and updates the module configuration in the system.

methods.name: importIntegrationModule
methods.description: Reads integration module data from a JSON file, identifies the module with code 'beanstream', loads it, and updates system configuration, replacing any existing module with the same code.
